`adhan.ogg` is the unchanged original (SHA-1 ada13592b01c12b0128af40035ed7a803e08b563).
`adhan.mp3` is Wikimedia's MP3 transcode of the same recording; no recitation edits were made by SHAMS. The recording remains available under CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution and license are also visible in the app player.

This is a human recording offered as a sample adhan, not synthesized speech. It is not labeled as a Jafari recording or a school-specific legal instruction. Playback requires an explicit user action; no background/autoplay scheduling is enabled.
